  "required_fixes": [
    "RF01 [P1] Render the assessment's session-critical header content. .inputs/academy/src/features/exam/components/exam-runner.tsx:219 publishes ExamTimer and its expiry callback in PageHeader.right, but packages/learner/src/page-header.ts:11-19 exports only breadcrumbs/fullBleed, and apps/desktop/src/features/academy/academy-view.tsx:232 renders only the trail. The timer therefore never mounts in the desktop: the learner cannot see remaining time and the normal expiry submission never runs. Independent React DOM probes using the actual runner/header store/learner bridge confirmed zero mounted timers and zero submissions after an expired deadline; rendering the published right slot as a positive control mounted the timer and submitted once. Acceptance: extend the Academy-owned host composition to render this status, preserving the server deadline and expiry behavior. Add composed desktop and native checks for an accessible visible countdown, server deadline updates, one expiry submission, late/unknown outcomes, and retirement when leaving the attempt or changing learner generation.",
    "RF02 [P2] Prevent overlapping lab draft saves from regressing confirmed state. .inputs/academy/src/features/labs/desktop/use-desktop-draft.ts:71 starts another request even when the same save is in flight; :89-100 unconditionally clears pending state and adopts every reply's version/confirmed work. An independent probe invoked two saves of A with the same mutation id, accepted the second reply as version 1, saved B as version 2, then delivered the first A reply. The hook regressed from confirmed version 2/saved to version 1/unsaved while still displaying B. Subsequent settling can submit an obsolete base version or create a false conflict against work already saved by this window. Acceptance: coalesce/serialize in-flight saves or otherwise bind completions so older replies cannot replace newer confirmed state or clear another pending save. Test autosave/submit overlap, changed work, reordered duplicate replies, monotonic confirmed versions, and stable mutation ids after an unknown outcome at the production draft/runner interface.",
    "RF03 [P2] Restore the explicitly retained learner workflows instead of treating their omission as completed parity. C06 milestone 2 requires avatar/account and learner feedback; its retained-workflow section and W66 require course reset. apps/desktop/src/features/academy/learner-provider.tsx:118 disables avatar upload, the shared CoursePage at .inputs/academy/src/features/units/pages/course-page.tsx:131 omits reset, and evidence/C06/workflow-matrix.md declares feedback absent and reset an admin action. The working-v1 sources still implement course reset and completed-lesson feedback (src/ui/academy/workflow.rs and studio_reading.rs) and photo upload/removal (profile_media.rs). The pinned Academy desktop-token allowlist includes progress.resetCourse, admin.feedback.submit, settings.avatarUploadUrl, settings.confirmAvatar and settings.removeAvatar; absence of current web controls does not make these learner operations unavailable or admin-only. Acceptance: provide the retained reset confirmation with counts/certificate preservation, completed-lesson feedback with its legitimate learner contract, and bounded native avatar upload/readback/removal through reviewed destination adapters. Exercise success, cancellation, denial and uncertain outcomes with synthetic fixtures and relevant native UI evidence; keep tenant credentials and arbitrary renderer network access out of these flows."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "EG01: C06's required interrupted-export case is not established. native-acceptance.json C06-N04 records a fixture print counter increasing from 0 to 1, and print_opens_the_native_sheet_once_and_changes_no_state tests successful admission against an in-memory printer. Neither exercises cancellation/interruption or a print/export failure; the production native print sheet is explicitly untested. The workflow matrix's statement that interruption leaves nothing to undo is reasoning, not an executed recovery case. Add source-bound interruption/cancellation/failure evidence for the certificate export path, distinguishing opening/admitting the sheet from producing an export and verifying unchanged learner state and honest UI behavior."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [
    "Align the Rust Shift scheduling fixture in crates/desktop-core/tests/academy_program/main.rs:205 with the actual router input: it currently uses runId/alertId/choice, while the real UI/native evidence uses shiftId/order/values. The independent concurrency property is still useful, and native C06-N06 supplies the real payload evidence, but valid literal inputs would make the fixture's contract coverage clearer."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints, the 306-entry source inventory, 89 referenced packet artifacts and run/log/artifact hashes; verified the passing C05 predecessor receipt and pinned Academy tree. No frozen-input mismatch was found.",
    "Independently executed the existing synthetic academy_program binary: all seven tests passed, including authority refusals, unknown submission outcomes, slow optional Shift reads, stale-account isolation and the print adapter. Its stores/vaults/printer are synthetic and its endpoint is loopback TLS.",

These are causal component/hook reproductions, not new native-window acceptance runs.",

Relevant AX trees and request records were inspected; native interaction was not repeated and spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded. The declared check set does not cover the missing exam timer or the export interruption gap.",

  ],
